title: Russian Guided Bombs Hit Izium, Jet-Powered Drone Strikes Kharkiv City — 10 Injured
detail: Russian forces struck the city of Izium in Kharkiv Oblast with three guided aerial bombs around 04:05 on August 23, injuring two people and damaging roughly 20 houses — one bomb hit the northern part of the city while two further strikes hit the Verkhnie Selyshche neighborhood, sparking an outbuilding fire and damaging power lines and vehicles. Overnight into the same morning, a Russian jet-powered 'Shahed' loitering drone struck a residential area in Kharkiv city's Osnovianskyi district, injuring eight people — five women aged 23 to 74, two men, and a 15-year-old boy who suffered acute stress — and setting two houses and an outbuilding ablaze over roughly 250 square meters.

title: Ukraine and Norway Sign 'Drone Deal' and Strategic Partnership 'Elizabeth' Agreement
detail: President Zelensky and Norwegian Prime Minister Jonas Gahr Støre signed two documents in Kyiv on August 23: a Defense and Security Cooperation Agreement under the 'Drone Deal' format covering joint production and development of unmanned systems and air defense across maritime, land, and air domains, and a Joint Declaration on a Strategic Partnership named the 'Elizabeth' agreement (after the medieval princess who became Queen of Norway). Zelensky said such partnerships should extend 'to every country in Europe,' noting Ukraine has now concluded comparable drone agreements with nine countries with fifteen more in development. Norway committed to maintaining roughly $9 billion in support for 2027 through its Nansen Support Programme, matching 2026 levels. The leaders also discussed strengthening Ukraine's air defense and winter preparations.

media.caption: Zelensky and Norwegian PM Jonas Gahr Støre sign the Drone Deal and 'Elizabeth' strategic partnership agreement in Kyiv, August 23, 2026
